name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; descriptor accurately reflects body: an offensive (damage-dealing) targeted-spell worker. No address residue. The 'offensive' contrast with the heal/cure/buff workers in the same file and the implicit BLINK-OVERLAY variant (vs the full_screen_flash sibling fd2_execute_offensive_full_screen_flash_spell @ 0x213B7) are both documented in the plate/comment, so the bare name is sufficient and correct.
purpose: Generic offensive targeted-spell worker (BLINK-OVERLAY animation variant): plays impact + overlay-blink animations, deducts caster MP, then applies fd2_calc_magic_damage to every target and shows the per-target damage/miss number.
logic_summary: Resets data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx to 0; calls fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target(caster,spell_id,n_targets,p_targets) and fd2_animate_spell_overlay_blink(...) for the per-target impact + blink-overlay animations; calls fd2_deduct_caster_mp(caster,spell_id). Loops iter=0..n_targets-1: target_id=p_targets[iter]; damage=fd2_calc_magic_damage(target_id,spell_id) (which applies the HP decrement internally); if damage!=0 draw fd2_show_damage_number(damage,0x5E '^',target_id) else fd2_show_miss_indicator(target_id). Closes with fd2_composite_battle_frame(0) + fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths() (the Pattern-A shared epilogue @ 0x21190, inlined in source; the binary borrows that fragment's POP/RET, this fn has no explicit RET of its own).
signature: void fd2_execute_offensive_targeted_spell(int caster, int spell_id, int n_targets, int p_targets)

params.semantics: Caster unit id; forwarded to both animation calls and to fd2_deduct_caster_mp.

params.reason: Generic Ghidra placeholder param_2; body uses it as the spell id everywhere. src already names it 'spell_id'. Rename applied in Stage 2.

params.semantics: Number of targets; the for-loop upper bound and the 3rd arg to the two animation calls.
params.reason: Generic Ghidra placeholder param_3; body uses it as the target count / loop bound. src already names it 'n_targets'. Rename applied in Stage 2.

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Pointer (as int) to the target-id byte array; indexed p_targets[iter] to fetch each target unit id.
params.reason: Current Ghidra name 'caster_unit_id' is actively WRONG (the caster is param_1); this 4th formal is the target-id byte-array pointer the caller pushes. The plate already flags it as misleading. src correctly names it 'p_targets'. Rename applied in Stage 2.

returns.semantics: No return value (visual/state effects only). In the binary the function has no explicit RET; it falls through the loop-exit JGE into the shared epilogue fragment @ 0x21190 which owns the POP/RET.
